title: Let's Pray / Play for Peace 2026
description: Supported backend and infrastructure work for a charity concert project combining classical music performance with audience-participatory real-time visual expression. The work included practical support around web/backend operation, nginx-based serving, and local/on-premise network server setup for event-side systems.
notes: This is not positioned as deep production infrastructure specialization, but as hands-on supporting experience with small-scale backend, server, and local network operations.
